title: RCP Bread Profile
description: Hardened bread profile (SR-PROF-001; DECISIONS #18). Evaluated ALONGSIDE core (validation = core AND profile[kind], DS-VAL-001): additive — tightens, never removes or redefines core fields (SSP-002). Numeric bounds live ONLY in x-rcp-bounds below (DS-VAL-003 adjusted): the CUE layer reads them; restating a number elsewhere is a defect.

bases.description: Bread scales on baker's percentage: a `flour` basis is mandatory (research 03: total flour = 100%, summed across the component tree via include_components).

profile.description: Bread-specific profile fields (DDT, preferment conventions) arrive with the Recipe Calculus (FEAT-CALC-001); the block stays open in v0.1.

reason.pt: Fora de 0,8%–2,5% de sal sobre a farinha, o pão está provavelmente mal formulado (típico: 1,8%–2,2%).
reason.en: Outside 0.8%–2.5% salt on flour the formula is probably wrong (typical: 1.8%–2.2%). Research 03.

reason.pt: Hidratação fora de 45%–110% da farinha está fora de qualquer estilo de pão conhecido.
reason.en: Hydration outside 45%–110% of flour is outside any known bread style. Research 03.
